layers.name: True colour
layers.what: Bands 4, 3 and 2. The place as a person sees it from above.
layers.read: Use it to show roads, buildings, water, smoke and floods.

layers.name: False colour (plants)
layers.read: Healthy plants show bright red. Towns show blue-grey. Water shows black.

layers.name: SWIR (burns and moisture)
layers.what: Bands 12, 8A and 4. Infrared light goes through smoke.
layers.read: Burned land shows dark red-brown. Plants show green. Water shows dark blue. Active fire shows bright orange.

layers.name: Agriculture
layers.read: Crops show bright green. Bare fields show brown or pink.

layers.name: Urban
layers.read: Buildings and roads show purple-grey. Plants show green. Water shows black.

layers.name: NDVI (plant cover)
layers.what: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index: (B08 - B04) / (B08 + B04).
layers.read: Green shows more plant cover. Red shows bare soil, buildings or water. Compare two dates to show forest loss or crop stress.

layers.name: NDMI (plant moisture)
layers.what: Normalized Difference Moisture Index: (B08 - B11) / (B08 + B11).
layers.read: Blue shows plants with much water. Red shows dry plants or bare soil. Use it to show drought.

layers.name: MNDWI (water)
layers.what: Modified Normalized Difference Water Index: (B03 - B11) / (B03 + B11).
layers.read: Blue shows open water. Red shows land. Compare two dates to show a flood or a lake that shrinks.

layers.name: NBR (burned land)
layers.read: Red shows burned or bare land. Green shows healthy plants. Compare dates before and after a fire.

layers.name: NDSI (snow and ice)
layers.what: Normalized Difference Snow Index: (B03 - B11) / (B03 + B11).
layers.read: Dark blue shows snow and ice. Use it to show snow cover or glaciers.
